Hello,

I saw your opening for a UI designer at Boch & Fernsh, and I was drawn to your focus on hand-made, niche web interfaces rather than templatized layouts.

At Ascent Business Solutions, I design digital and print creatives while building reusable visual systems and templates that cut turnaround time. Before that, I worked on wireframing, prototyping, and usability testing at AT Creation.

My B2B UX case study, Bounceless, demonstrates my approach to building cleaner verification experiences for teams handling email lists: https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/

I am currently based in Nagpur and ready to relocate for your Mumbai office. Would you be open to taking a look at Bounceless?

Ananya

Ananya Saini
+91-8605846929
